title: File exceeds 1000 lines (1179 lines)
detail: File is 1179 lines, well above the 1000-line maintainability threshold. Large files typically contain many unrelated concerns and make code review and change-isolation harder. Suggested fix: split into smaller modules by responsibility.

title: Exception context suppressed: 1 `raise` statements without `from` (L400)
detail: Raising a new exception inside an `except` block without `raise NewExc() from exc` discards the original traceback, making debugging harder. Suggested fix: use `raise NewExc() from exc` or `raise NewExc() from None` if suppression is intentional.
